root_cause.text: The error handling path (`err_register`) in `mpc52xx_spi_probe` fails to release registered interrupts (`ms->irq0`, `ms->irq1`) and cancel pending work (`ms->work`) upon controller registration failure, leaving active handlers pointing to freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `free_irq(ms->irq0, ms)`, `free_irq(ms->irq1, ms)`, and `cancel_work_sync(&ms->work)` under the `err_register` label in `drivers/spi/spi-mpc52xx.c` to clean up resources when initialization fails.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource leaks in the probe error path by freeing interrupts and cancelling pending work upon registration failure.
intent_record.what: Added free_irq calls for ms->irq0 and ms->irq1, and cancel_work_sync for ms->work in the err_register error handling path of mpc52xx_spi_probe.
intent_record.how: Ensures that allocated interrupts are properly released and pending work is cancelled if the SPI host registration fails, preventing resource leaks and potential undefined behavior.
